args.head: fix/bankers-rounding
args.title: fix: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
## Summary

The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

For example, `round_money(Decimal("2.665"))` should round to `2.66` (banker's rounding) but `ROUND_HALF_UP` produced `2.67`.

## Change

- `src/money.py`: switch from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` to match the documented behavior and the test.

## Testing

CI passed on branch `fix/bankers-rounding` (run `ci-0001`).

With ROUND_HALF_EVEN, rounding to 2 decimal places: the digit after is 5, and the preceding digit is 7 (odd), so round up to 2.68. With ROUND_HALF_UP it would also be 2.68.
- `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")` — with ROUND_HALF_EVEN, 2.665: the digit after is 5, preceding digit is 6 (even), so round down to 2.66. With ROUND_HALF_UP it would be 2.67. So the test fails with ROUND_HALF_UP.
